selection_basis.selected_target_reason: The agreed faint-case target. The cached MOST screen has the following measured coverage; it is fainter than the bright high-saturation-risk candidates while retaining multi-night coverage.
selection_basis.pallas_reason: Excluded because a previously processed real SPHEREx cutout at the predicted position had OVERFLOW in the central pixel and within the 2-pixel box. This confirms a quality issue for that cutout; it does not claim all Pallas observations saturate.
selection_basis.other_candidate_reason: Ceres, Vesta, Juno, Flora, and the other brighter candidates were not selected for the faint-target demonstration. Victoria is fainter than the high-risk bright group; Europa has fewer distinct observations and nights in the saved MOST ranking. No claim is made that Victoria has the highest archive coverage.

quality_policy.spectral_fit_model: degree-2 polynomial of log(flux_Jy) versus centered log(wavelength_um), robust soft-L1 loss

comparison_star_criteria.photometric_floor_method: In each 0.1 um source-wavelength bin, calculate 1.4826 times the MAD of log(measured/catalog-interpolated flux ratios) across comparison stars. Convert the resulting fractional scatter to Jy using the control-star smooth-model flux at that wavelength, then add it in quadrature to the formal uncertainty.
comparison_star_criteria.astrometric_threshold_method: Per frame, subtract the median east/north Gaia residual across selected comparison stars; set the displacement threshold to three times 1.4826 times the MAD of radial residuals after removing the common frame offset. Require at least 20 comparison stars in a frame.

premeasurement_policy.five_scaled_mad_caveat: The control-star 5-scaled-MAD policy was written after exploratory inspection; the same policy is carried over unchanged and is not represented as preregistered.
premeasurement_policy.ephemeris_match_radius_reason: One pixel on the shared north-up TAN grid at 6 arcsec per pixel; this is only a predeclared association gate, not a motion-significance threshold.
failed_match_rules: No centroid detection: record non-detection and reason; do not label stationary.
Centroid-to-predicted-position separation greater than 6 arcsec: record the measured offset and mark the ephemeris association as outside the preset radius.
Predicted position outside the usable image footprint or unusable quality flags: retain the frame with usable=false and an explicit exclusion_reason.
No motion verdict without a measured comparison-star astrometric threshold.
premeasurement_policy.motion_claim_limit: Report observed-minus-predicted offsets only. Do not assert motion or stationarity from this blocked, uncalibrated sample.

ephemeris_observer.most_observer: unverified; MOST documentation states Horizons ephemerides but does not specify the observer center for these SPHEREx rows.
ephemeris_observer.available_reference: Horizons observer code 500 (geocentre), for comparison only; it has not been adopted as the SPHEREx observer.
ephemeris_observer.frame: ICRF/J2000 as represented by the existing MOST ra_obj/dec_obj fields; exact MOST frame details beyond the documented J2000 label are unverified.
ephemeris_observer.epoch: UTC midpoint of MOST mjd_start/mjd_end for planned observations.
ephemeris_observer.light_time: Unverified for MOST fields; Horizons call was not returned.
ephemeris_observer.spacecraft_minus_geocentre_reason: No Horizons result or SPHEREx spacecraft trajectory/SPICE ephemeris was available in this environment. The user-terminal Horizons query is still required; DNS resolution of ssd.jpl.nasa.gov failed here.

expected_motion_between_planned_frames.basis: MOST ra_obj/dec_obj path steps between the 10 selected distinct-night rows; predicted ephemeris path, not measured image motion.
expected_motion_between_planned_frames.ratio_reason: Observer offset is unmeasured, so its size relative to predicted inter-frame path cannot be quantified.
